chunks: Muhammad ibn Hammam narrated to us, he said: Ahmad ibn Mabindath narrated to us, he said: Ahmad ibn Hilal narrated to us, from Is'haq ibn Sabbah, from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him) that he said:
Indeed, this [authority/imamate] will flow to the one who will bear the burden [of leadership].
ai.seo_question: Who will inherit the imamate according to Imam al-Rida's narration?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam al-Rida (AS) alludes to the imminent transfer of the imamate to the one who will bear the 'burden' (al-haml) of leadership, a phrase Shia exegetes interpret as referring to Imam al-Mahdi (AJF). This highlights the concept of the Imam assuming authority early in life, carrying the weight of divine guidance and communal responsibility from a young age. The term 'al-haml' underscores the heavy spiritual and political mantle that distinguishes the final Imam in the Shia eschatological narrative.
